Name: Feast of Souls
Desc: Soul Fragments grant 1% increased damage for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

Name: Felbound
Desc: Your movement speed is increased by 3%.

Name: Final Hour
Desc: Passive bonuses granted by each stack of Voidfall persist for 8 sec after being consumed.

Name: Flamebound
Desc: Hungering Slash has 2 yd increased radius and 50% increased critical strike damage bonus.

Name: Focused Hatred
Desc: Voidsurge deals 50% increased damage when it strikes a single target. Each additional target reduces this bonus by 10%.

Name: Furious
Desc: Attacks and abilities that generate Fury deal 3% increased damage.

Name: Gift of the Void
Desc: Your critical strike chance is increased by 2%.

Name: Harness the Cosmos
Desc: Voidfall Meteor damage increased by 15%.

Name: Illidari Knowledge
Desc: Reduces magic damage taken by 3%.

Name: Impending Apocalypse
Desc: Each Collapsing Star you cast increases the damage of your next Collapsing Star by 30%.

Name: Incorruptible Spirit
Desc: Each Soul Fragment you consume shields you for an additional 15% of the amount healed.

Name: Internal Struggle
Desc: Increases your mastery by 2.2%.

Name: Keen Edge
Desc: Reaver's Glaive damage is increased by 20% and other Physical-only damage is increased by 10%.

Name: Keen Engagement
Desc: Reaver's Glaive generates 20 Fury.

Name: Know Your Enemy
Desc: Gain critical strike damage equal to 40% of your critical strike chance.

Name: Live by the Glaive
Desc: When you parry an attack or have one of your attacks parried, restore 2% of max health and 10 Fury. This effect may only occur once every 5 sec.

Name: Midnight
Desc: Collapsing Star always critically strikes.

Name: Midnight
Desc: All Cosmic damage dealt increased by 3%. Collapsing Star's critical strike damage is increased by 50% of your critical strike chance.

Name: Monster Rising
Desc: Intellect increased by 15% while not in demon form.

Name: Otherworldly Focus
Desc: Collapsing Star and Voidfall meteors deal 35% increased damage when striking a single target. Each additional target reduces this bonus by 5%.

Name: Painbringer
Desc: Consuming a Soul Fragment reduces all damage you take by 3% for 8 sec.

Name: Path to Oblivion
Desc: Each stack of Voidfall grants 3% increased movement speed.

Name: Phase Shift
Desc: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% reduced damage taken.

Name: Pursuit
Desc: Mastery increases your movement speed.

Name: Pursuit of Angriness
Desc: Movement speed increased by 1% per 10 Fury.

Name: Quickened Sigils
Desc: Your Sigils activate 1 second faster.

Name: Remorseless
Desc: Attacks and abilities that spend Fury deal 3% increased damage.

Name: Scars of Suffering
Desc: Increases Versatility by 4% and reduces threat generated by 8%.

Name: Set Fire to the Pain
Effect: Buff: Set Fire to the Pain
Desc: 5% of all non-Fire damage taken is instead taken as Fire damage over 6 sec. Fire damage taken reduced by 10%.

Name: Shattered Destiny
Desc: The duration of your active demon form is extended by 0.1 sec per 12 Fury spent.

Name: Soul Sigils
Desc: Afflicting an enemy with a Sigil generates 1 Soul Fragment.

Name: Soul Splitter
Desc: Any time you would generate one or more Soul Fragments, you have a 2% chance to generate an additional Soul Fragment.

Name: Soulcrush
Desc: The effects of Frailty are doubled.

Name: Soulmonger
Desc: When consuming a Soul Fragment would heal you above full health it shields you instead, up to a maximum of 42,690.

Name: Star Fragments
Desc: Collapsing Star now generates 3 Soul Fragments.

Name: Sweet Release
Desc: Your chance to shatter a Soul Fragment from enemies you damage is increased by 2%.

Name: Sweet Suffering
Desc: The duration of Feast of Souls is increased by 1 sec. Feast of Souls Soul Fragments grant 1% increased damage for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

Name: Swift Erasure
Desc: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% Haste.

Name: Tempered Steel
Desc: Physical damage increased by 12%.

Name: Thrill of the Fight
Desc: After consuming both enhancements, gain Thrill of the Fight, increasing the damage of your next Reaver's Glaive by 30% and increasing Haste by 8% for 30 sec.

Name: Unrestrained Fury
Desc: Increases maximum Fury by 20.

Name: Untethered Fury
Desc: Maximum Fury increased by 20.

Name: Void Reaver
Desc: Frailty now also reduces all damage you take from afflicted targets by 5%.

Name: Voidrage
Desc: Your Mastery is increased by 2%.

Name: Volatile Instinct
Desc: Entering demon form causes your next Voidsurge to repeat after a short delay.

Name: Vulnerability
Desc: Frailty now also increases all damage you deal to afflicted targets by 3%.

Name: Will of the Illidari
Desc: Increases maximum health by 3%.

Name: World Killer
Desc: The third Voidfall meteor strike called down in sequence is larger, has 50% increased area, deals 50% increased damage, and generates 1 Soul Fragment.

Name: Wounded Quarry
Desc: Expose weaknesses in the target of your Reaver's Mark, causing your Physical damage to any enemy to also deal 30% of the damage dealt to your marked target as Chaos, and sometimes shatter a Soul Fragment.
